//: Model tier configuration. Tiers follow docs/LESSONS.md: the strong model does the actual translation, the cheap model does everything else. Swap providers freely — that is the point of this harness. provider: litellm (default, use '<provider>/<model>' ids), openai (any OpenAI-compatible api_base), or inference_client (HF Inference Providers). Extra keys are passed to the model constructor (temperature, max_tokens, api_base, ...).

agent_overrides.//: Per-agent experiments, e.g. "stray-phrase-detector": {"model_id": "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash"} — keys here override the agent's tier spec.

pricing.//: Fallback $/MTok when litellm cannot price a response: {"substring-of-model-id": {"in": X, "out": Y}}
